units.evidence: Officially named business school hosts SCM programme leadership and explicitly Operations/OR/logistics faculty research. Full faculty structure does not establish imported combined research-topic list as a department.

decisions.reason: Imported recruitment subject list is not a verified department name. Current official school identity and SCM research/teaching host retained; similar current head remit is not silently relabelled a department.

sources.note: Official footer names École de Management Léonard de Vinci; current programme navigation includes MSc Supply Chain Management and DBA.

Current faculty structure explicitly names a head of Innovation, Systèmes d’Information et Supply Chain, but does not label that remit a department; MSc SCM and procurement/SCM specialisation have named heads. Collaboration with separately named ESILV engineering school.
Research shared through De Vinci Research Center with engineering science colleagues; three interdisciplinary axes, not the imported recruiting-topic department.
Current 2026–2029 offering is Doctorate of Business Administration (DBA), aimed at experienced professionals; do not recode PhD. Complete school programme navigation read.

De Vinci Higher Education Research Center shared by distinct business EMLV, engineering ESILV and digital IIM schools. Generic research partnerships mention doctoral programmes without actual award or eligible programme.

limitations: Current formal type of Innovation, Systèmes d’Information et Supply Chain remit remains unverified. Shared center has interdisciplinary engineering scope but individual eligible engineering units/programmes have not been reconciled. EMLV is a business school; no unsupported university status claimed.
